purpose: Teach: 年来/腫れ/固まり/がんばろ/いただこ/叫び声/過ごさ/細やか

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、ぼくの十年来の友達みたい。
lines.en: Mom, Dad—you're like my best friend from way back.
lines.style: Soft wonder, eyes bright. Quick up-beat on the connection. Small proud smile in the voice. Natural, unselfconscious—a child's simple certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お顔、虫刺されで、腫れちゃったね。
lines.en: Yeah. Your face got pretty puffy from the bug bites, didn't it?
lines.style: Gentle noticing, not worried. Warm maternal tone—she's already planning how to help. Soft concern underneath, delivered matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: プリン、冷蔵庫で、ちゃんと固まりました!
lines.en: The pudding set perfectly in the fridge!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Quick pace on the opening. Real joy—he made something work. Bouncy energy without shouting, eager to share the success.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日のテスト、一緒にがんばろうね。
lines.en: Let's do your best together on that test tomorrow, okay?
lines.style: Calm, steady reassurance. Lean in slightly—this is her protecting him without fussing. Warm but matter-of-fact, the tone of a mother who shows up.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ご飯、おかわりいただこうかな。
lines.en: Maybe I'll have seconds on rice.
lines.style: Small polite hesitation, then a gentle reach forward. Six-year-old politeness—asking permission without quite asking. Hopeful underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。外で、叫び声、すごかったね、さっき。
lines.en: Yeah. Someone was screaming outside pretty loudly a little while ago.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Her voice stays calm, steady—processing something she noticed. Not alarmed, but paying attention. Slight trailing-off, checking his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、家でゆっくり過ごさないと、もったいないね。
lines.en: We can't waste summer break—we should take it slow at home.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom from a child's mouth. Quiet, almost to himself but wanting her to hear. Simple certainty about something that matters. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんの優しさ、細やかで、嬉しいよ。
lines.en: Your kindness is so thoughtful, Sho. It makes me happy.
lines.style: Quiet warmth, eyes soft. Speak directly to him—not performing the compliment, meaning it. Slow pace on the last phrase. The tone of being truly seen.
